item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-728c26e31901697c","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 2 October 2023, during pro-Sisi reelection rallies in Marsa Matrouh, witnesses reported that a police officer acted violently toward youths; subsequent footage showed chants calling for Sisi's departure and an end to military rule, alongside the tearing and burning of Sisi-support signs.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.3","3B.8","4B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The event occurred at a pro-Sisi rally and involved police securing the event; the reported officer conduct is attributed to a police officer, not personally to Sisi.","limitations":["Witnesses spoke anonymously and the account does not establish Sisi's direct order or knowledge."]},{"source_id":"SRC-728c26e31901697c","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Following the Marsa Matrouh rally disturbance, police reportedly arrested 67 people; 51 were later released, while 10 were detained by the Matrouh Public Prosecution and six were referred to State Security Prosecution, all on charges including rioting, property destruction, or inciting violence.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The detentions were carried out by police and prosecutorial authorities during Sisi's presidency; the source does not report a personal presidential order.","limitations":["The source reports lawyers' and anonymous sources' accounts; guilt was not established in the cited units."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fe6b4788622d85eb","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Committee for Justice documented the death of detainee Alhadi Mohmed Mohammed Alhadi in Wadi El Natrun Prison 430, alleging that prison administration deliberately delayed necessary medical care after his blood pressure rose; the organization counted 33 deaths in Egyptian prisons and detention facilities during 2023.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.9","6B.2","6B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The alleged neglect is attributed to prison administration; the broader detention system operated under the Interior Ministry and Prison Authority during Sisi's presidency.","limitations":["The source is an advocacy organization's documentation and allegation; it calls for a neutral investigation, which the cited units do not report as completed."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb650843db247314c","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On 16 September 2023, Sisi directed the government to increase the exceptional cost-of-living allowance for public-sector employees from EGP 300 to EGP 600, raise the minimum wage for sixth-grade employees from EGP 3,500 to EGP 4,000, and increase the tax-exemption threshold from EGP 36,000 to EGP 45,000.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.8","5B.9","6B.1","6B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Egyptian presidency explicitly attributes the directives to President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi.","limitations":["The source records directives, not their subsequent execution or distributional effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb650843db247314c","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On 16 September 2023, Sisi directed a 15% increase in financial benefits for Takaful and Karama beneficiaries, covering five million families, and doubled the exceptional grant for pensioners and beneficiaries from EGP 300 to EGP 600, covering 11 million citizens.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.8","5B.9","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Egyptian presidency explicitly attributes the directives to President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi.","limitations":["The source records announced measures, not implementation quality or actual incidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb650843db247314c","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Sisi directed the Agricultural Bank of Egypt to launch an initiative to ease the burden on small farmers in default and directed that defaulters owing the Authority for Reconstruction Projects and Agricultural Development be exempted from delayed-payment interest and fines through the end of 2024.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","6B.3","6B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The directives were issued in September 2023; the implementation period extended through 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The Egyptian presidency explicitly attributes the directives to President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi.","limitations":["The source contains a date inconsistency, referring to implementation of the farmers' initiative before 1 January 2022 despite the September 2023 publication; it does not report implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2872be92f9fed150","start_unit":16,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"On 3 May 2023, the Egyptian government launched a national dialogue announced by Sisi in April 2022 to address economic and political challenges, but International IDEA reported that arrests of opposition politicians and activists overshadowed the process and raised concerns about expression, inclusivity, and meaningful opposition participation.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.10","8B.1","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The dialogue was announced by Sisi and launched by his government; the reported crackdown is attributed to the Egyptian government and security authorities.","limitations":["International IDEA summarizes reporting from multiple sources and does not provide case-level arrest details in the cited units."]},{"source_id":"SRC-789e26717250bd46","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In a 2023 joint statement, the Arab-OIC Committee on Gaza, including Egypt, called for an immediate ceasefire, unrestricted humanitarian access through all routes and crossings, protection of civilians and civilian infrastructure, and accountability for violations of international humanitarian law.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.4","2B.7","2B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The statement is identified as a 2023 government publication; the committee was formed on 11 November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"This was a collective foreign-ministers' position including Egypt, not a statement personally issued
